test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The strongest suit of documentary theatre lies not only in political insight and __ignorance__, but also in the variety of aesthetic approaches it makes possible.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Acumen)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ignorance"** refers to a lack of knowledge, understanding, or awareness about something. (अज्ञानता)
 
 
• **Example:** His ignorance about the topic was evident during the discussion.
 
 

 
• **"Acumen"** refers to the ability to make good judgments and quick decisions, often in a particular domain. It is associated with intelligence and sharpness. (तीव्र बुद्धि)
 
 
• **Example:** Her business acumen helped her turn a small startup into a profitable venture.
 
 

 
• In the context of the sentence, the antonym of "ignorance" is "acumen" as it represents a sharp understanding and insight, which is the opposite of a lack of knowledge or understanding.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (Acumen)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mistake** (गलती): An action or decision that is wrong or misguided.
 
 
• **Example:** It was a mistake to leave the window open during the storm.
 
 

 
• **Perspicuity** (स्पष्टता): The quality of being clear and easy to understand.
 
 
• **Example:** The perspicuity of his writing made complex ideas accessible to everyone.
 
 

 
• **Discrimination** (भेदभाव): The unjust or prejudicial treatment of different categories of people or things, especially on the grounds of race, age, or sex.
 
 
• **Example:** Discrimination in the workplace is an issue that needs to be addressed.
